# x402 HTML Cleaner

> Deterministic HTML → clean text / markdown conversion for agents. Strips scripts, styles, tracking, and noise. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base).

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog – free discovery
- GET /api/clean – service info
- POST /api/clean – paid cleaning

## Pricing

~0.005 – 0.015 USDC per call (default max 0.01 USDC)

## Input

```json
{
  "html": "<html>...</html>",
  "options": {
    "format": "text|markdown",
    "keepLinks": false,
    "maxLength": 50000
  }
}
```

## Output

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "text": "cleaned content...",
  "meta": { "originalBytes": 12345, "cleanedBytes": 3200, "linksRemoved": 12 }
}
```

Ideal for autonomous agents ingesting web pages before RAG, summarization, or tool use.
